_doc: Data sources referenced by geo-objects.json, resource-stats.json and questions/*.json. See docs/GEOGRAPHIC_DATA_SOURCES.md.

sources.name: Natural Earth
sources.attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com.
sources.notes: Country shapes (1:110m, via the world-atlas 2.0 package) and river/lake geometry (1:50m) for the map layers.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.notes: Coordinates (P625), countries (P17), mouths of watercourses (P403), mountain ranges (P4552), retrieved with the wbgetentities API.

sources.name: Wikipedia (English)
sources.notes: Used to confirm descriptive facts (what a strait connects, where a river rises). Only facts are used; no text is copied.

sources.name: U.S. Geological Survey, Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026
sources.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey, Mineral Commodity Summaries, February 2026
sources.notes: World mine production and reserves tables of the copper, cobalt, lithium, gold, iron ore, nickel and rare earths chapters. Production years 2024 (reported or estimated) and 2025 (estimated); reserves and resources as published in the 2026 edition.

sources.name: Nile Basin Initiative
sources.notes: The Nile basin is shared by 11 countries: the 10 NBI members plus Eritrea (observer).

sources.name: World Bank, World Development Indicators
sources.attribution: The World Bank: World Development Indicators
sources.notes: EN.POP.DNST (population density), SP.POP.TOTL (population), TX.VAL.MRCH.CD.WT (merchandise exports), via api.worldbank.org/v2.
